target.browser: Codex in-app browser, Chromium user-agent major 155

source.observerSnapshot: Successful native samples used the canvas/focus readiness corrections before the final named-preset arm guard was added. The later guard is regression-tested; these measurements are not represented as samples of that later observer revision.

method.input: Native trusted keyboard events through the ordinary game controls; observer never drives input.
method.memoryCounter: Nonstandard performance.memory endpoint counters; not peak decoded-media or GPU memory.
method.otherWorkload: Audio/source tests were stopped. A public dependency downloader ran concurrently; unrelated Mac activity was not controlled. No causal attribution of outliers or load times.
method.viewportNote: Each scenario retains its own measured viewport. Team and introductory Duel were 1280 x 561; the heavy Duel finale was 640 x 281. All reported DPR 2. No cross-scenario timing comparison is justified.

postSampleScreenshot.note: Screenshot is after the timed 30-second window; do not substitute its HUD for the sample end.

duel.status: bounded active native heavy-finale sample recorded
duel.selection: Native mission-library exact card -> Replace and play -> 72% goal verified -> Pause -> arm -> Resume.
duel.postSampleScreenshot: The screenshot shows the later terminal Rematch: Expedition Decider screen and provides mission/result proof only, not the active 30-second endpoint.
duel.missionSelectionTiming: The Choose mission timing was discarded after focus left. Only deliberate Resume-to-ready timing is retained; no complete heavy-finale load timing is claimed.

lifecycleObservations.kind: native browser UI observed by operator
checks: Escape visibly pauses; deliberate Resume resumes.
Moving focus to the observer Mode control produces a shared PAUSED state.
At the paused 0:49 and 32.1% state, held D and ArrowLeft for 700 ms leave time, HUD and Resume unchanged.
lifecycleObservations.limits: This demonstrates this browser keyboard/focus boundary, not physical controller, mobile, screen-reader or BFCache native qualification.

lifecycleObservations.kind: native browser UI observed by operator
checks: Held D and ArrowRight for 700 ms do not resume.
Deliberate Resume race resumes with the same visible scores and lives.
Moving focus to the observer Mode control pauses both boards again.
lifecycleObservations.limits: Observed on this introductory native mission. Not heavy-finale or physical-controller certification.

supersededDiagnostics.reason: Observer false negative: #coop-play uses display:contents and therefore has no layout box while its actual canvas is visible. Corrected observer checks canvas plus ancestor/overlay gates.

limits: One 30-second sample for one Team finale and one Duel finale, plus one introductory Duel sample, on one Mac/browser. Other selected finales and repeat/sustained sessions are not covered.
No matched baseline: this is an observation, not a performance-improvement or budget-pass claim.
Team: 4 intervals above 33.34 ms and 1 above 50 ms; introductory Duel: 4 and 2; heavy Duel: 0 and 0. A zero page-wide long-task count does not contradict a slow frame-scheduling interval.
Used JS heap fell between endpoints; garbage collection may explain the fall. No peak memory or leak conclusion.
Complete decoded image/audio/GPU memory is unavailable. Canvas/DOM-image pixel estimates exclude off-DOM assets, copies, drivers and compositor allocations.
Local source preparation/menu timing includes browser scheduling and module compilation; no OS-level cold cache established.
No physical gamepad, mobile/handheld, assistive-technology or paired human enjoyment certification.
Heavy Duel used 640 x 281 CSS pixels rather than the 1280 x 561 Team/introductory viewport. No matched scenario/viewport baseline was collected.

duelIntroductory.status: additional native input/performance sample; not the requested heavy finale
duelIntroductory.requestedSelectionContract: The select handoff reveals the native library row. It does not adopt a replacement runtime until its explicit Play action.
duelIntroductory.postSampleNote: Operator observed a subsequent hit leaving 2 lives for both seats; timed sample ended with 3 lives each. Do not substitute post-sample states.

observerCorrections.resolution: Read the visible canvas, with hidden/inert-ancestor and pause guards retained.

observerCorrections.issue: Named preset could otherwise measure the currently selected default mission
observerCorrections.resolution: Arming now rejects a mismatched native mission and displays a choose-requested-mission message; changing it after arming discards the sample. Incoming select still only reveals the row and does not drive gameplay.

selectedActualHostCasesPassed: Team missed-focus notification causes pause before polling or stepping and requires explicit Resume.
Duel hidden/zero bounds and BFCache restore preserve runs/checkpoints and retire stale resize callbacks.
